temperature_below_minimum.message: {temperature} °C is below the {min_temp} °C minimum for hvac_mode {hvac_mode}. Include hvac_mode in the same action call to check against the mode you are switching to instead.

too_many_devices.description:
{device_name} has room for four registered accounts and all four are taken, so Home Assistant cannot register itself. Registrations never expire, and the module never replaces one.

To free a slot:

1. Open the Smart M-Air app on a phone that no longer needs this unit.
2. Remove the unit from that app. Each account can only remove itself, and phones sharing one Smart M-Air account take up a single slot between them.
3. Send any command to the climate entity. Home Assistant registers again with it and this message clears.

If no slot can be freed, the module has to be set up again from scratch.
too_many_devices.title: Too many accounts registered on {device_name}
